caption:
Most cleaning business owners know their revenue.

Very few know these 3 numbers 👇

1️⃣ Cost per booked job
2️⃣ Quote-to-booking rate
3️⃣ How many first-time clients go recurring

Miss one and you're paying for leads that never turn into money. Miss all three and more ads will only make it worse.

Score yourself honestly. 0, 1, 2 or 3?

Want the sheet that calculates all 3 from last month's numbers?
Comment NUMBERS and I'll DM it to you.
